audit.evidence: Multiple sources (Cars.com, Infiniti forums, Engine Patrol, Club Armada) confirm the VK56VD timing chain stretch issue is real but is specifically tied to 2011-2013 QX56/M56/Q70 models and was subject to an official Infiniti recall (P6305) in May 2016; Nissan updated the timing chain components when the vehicle was rebranded as QX80 in 2014, so the 2014-2017 QX80 model years listed are largely unaffected. DTC codes P0300 and P0011 are consistent with owner-reported symptoms, and repair costs of $2,000-$5,000 align with reported quotes (~$6,000 reported in one case, with labor alone running $1,200-$2,000+).
